section.label: The Paddock
section.title: Machines of the Moment
section.description: The most beautiful motorcycles released around the world — curated the way a collector curates a cabinet.

motorcycles.name: Royal Enfield Classic 650
motorcycles.description: The postwar silhouette of the original Classic, carried by the smoothest parallel twin Enfield has ever built. Chrome tank, hand-striped panels — a machine that looks inherited, not bought.
motorcycles.imageSource: Official Royal Enfield product gallery (royalenfield.com), Classic 650 in Teal

motorcycles.name: Ducati Panigale V4
motorcycles.description: Bologna's latest masterwork — a sculpture that happens to produce over 200 horsepower. The seventh generation refines the aluminium monocoque into something close to jewellery.
motorcycles.imageSource: Wikimedia Commons: 'Ducati Panigale V4S 2025.jpg' by AVMOTO, CC BY-SA 4.0

motorcycles.name: BMW R 12 nineT
motorcycles.description: Bavaria's love letter to its own history. The boxer twin sits in the frame like an heirloom watch in a display case — engineering as quiet confidence.
motorcycles.imageSource: Wikimedia Commons: '2024-06 BMW R12-nineT right.jpg' by Wikisympathisant, CC BY-SA 4.0

motorcycles.name: Moto Guzzi V7 Special
motorcycles.description: Built on the shores of Lake Como since 1921 — the oldest motorcycle factory in continuous operation. The V7's transverse twin is Italian craft at its most unhurried and assured.
motorcycles.imageSource: Wikimedia Commons: 'Moto Guzzi V7 Special 850 2025.jpg', CC BY-SA 4.0

motorcycles.name: Norton Commando 961
motorcycles.description: Hand-assembled in Solihull, polished like regimental silver. The 961 is not transportation — it is a family portrait that happens to start on the first press.
motorcycles.imageSource: Wikimedia Commons: 'Norton Commando 961 Sport.jpg', CC BY-SA 2.0
